auto_ticket.description:
AutoTicket opens a ticket for a WhatsApp message that does not continue an open one. Off by
default, so a tenant that answers WhatsApp from the notifications inbox is not flooded.

forwarding_address.description: ForwardingAddress is where the tenant auto-forwards its support mailbox.

last_received_at.description:
LastReceivedAt is when the last forwarded email arrived, null until the first one: the
forwarding verify step shows the address as working once it is set.

requester_name.description:
Requester contact, stored in metadata as requester_name/requester_email/requester_phone on
every create path. Ticket events carry it so the requester is told by email, WhatsApp or SMS.

sla_first_response_minutes.description: The elapsed minutes to first response and to resolution in the policy's clock, net of pauses.

sla_paused_at.description: SLAPausedAt is set while a pending status stops the SLA clock.

whatsapp_window_expires_at.description:
WhatsAppWindowExpiresAt is when the 24-hour WhatsApp reply window closes (derived from
metadata whatsapp_last_inbound_at, never stored); null for other channels and for a
WhatsApp ticket with no inbound message yet.

internal.description: Internal attachments belong to an internal note and are never shown to the customer.

channel.description:
Channel, ExternalID, Sender and EmailSubject describe a customer message that came in on a
channel (email or WhatsApp). They are read from the comment metadata, never stored apart,
and are empty on every other comment.

mentions.description: Mentions are the agent ids the comment @mentions (staff comments only).
